title: I think incremental/clicker games have finally gone too far, so I made the most meta one I could think of — you don't even get to play.
author: eyesolatedgames
selftext:
*Incremental Watcher* is a game where you watch simulated streamers play a “Needle in a Haystack” game.

You don't play the game. You don't help them. You just watch them endlessly search through hay.

Eventually they find the needle. You have about five to ten seconds to hit 👍 before they log off. That's the entire game.

The more I looked at the recent wave of increasingly absurd incremental games — finding one needle among millions of pieces of hay, watching paint dry, sorting millions of grains of wheat — the more I wondered what happens if you take the whole thing one step further:

**What if the game isn't even yours to play? What if your only job is to watch someone else play it and maintain enough attention to click a button at the right moment?**

So I made that.

**100% AI-built. ONE go. ZERO iteration.**

[https://eyesolated.itch.io/incremental-watcher](https://eyesolated.itch.io/incremental-watcher)

It's 100% free with no monetary incentive for me whatsoever.
